<thought>Based on the NMR and mass‑spectrometry data the molecule contains a chlorinated aromatic ring (6 aromatic carbons, chlorine evident from the isotopic pattern) and an aliphatic isopropyl fragment (one CH attached to a hetero‑atom at ~49 ppm, two equivalent CH₃ at ~11 ppm and a CH₂ at ~26 ppm). These two fragments can be joined to give the full structure. The SMILES for the fragments are therefore:

['Clc1ccccc1', 'CC(C)C']

</thought>
<final_answer>['Clc1ccccc1', 'CC(C)C']</final_answer>
